user.title: Connect to your BEAAM
user.description: Uses only the local BEAAM API, no cloud. You can get the API key (sk_beaam_…) as described on https://neoom.com/developers.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the BEAAM, e.g. 192.168.1.28
data_description.api_key: Local BEAAM API key, starts with sk_beaam_

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate BEAAM
reauth_confirm.description: The BEAAM at {host} rejected the API key. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the BEAAM. Check the host and that the BEAAM is reachable.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This BEAAM site is already configured.
abort.wrong_site: This is a different BEAAM site than the one configured.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends a command to a device connected to the BEAAM, e.g. TARGET_POWER for a battery or MAX_CURRENT_CHARGE for a charging point.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device connected to the BEAAM (not the BEAAM itself).

key.name: Key
key.description: Data point key, must be controllable in the site configuration.

value.name: Value
value.description: Value to set (number, true/false or text).

update_setting.name: Update setting
update_setting.description: Changes a device setting, e.g. OPERATING_MODE_EMS or GRID_FEED_IN_PRIORITIZATION_TIMES.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device connected to the BEAAM (not the BEAAM itself).

push_states.name: Push states
push_states.description: Feeds values into a 'Generic' device configured on connect.neoom.com (e.g. a meter or heat pump that the BEAAM cannot read itself).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The generic device on the BEAAM.

states.name: States
states.description: Mapping of data point key to value, e.g. {"ACTIVE_POWER": 1250}.
